title: Access members of an MCP request's _meta
description: The `_meta` members an MCP client sends to an MCP server that is an Access PEP (§11.2, OP-154 m.6 (a)). A `tools/call` carries the actor Instance's Actor Intent Statement and the validity window it signed; a `subscriptions/listen` carries the pre-signed `continue` statement for its checkpoint. Other members of `_meta` are not Access's and are ignored here. None of them is a capability: the server asks Access with them and decides nothing itself.

io.suiss.access/ais.description: The actor Instance's AIS over the call's intent: a COSE_Sign1 (content type application/access-ais+cbor), base64url without padding, exactly as signed.

io.suiss.access/validity.description: The intent validity window the AIS was signed over.

io.suiss.access/continue.description: The actor's pre-signed `continue` AIS for the stream's checkpoint, base64url without padding (A-8, AG-15, OP-154 m.6 (c)).
